day_shape: 73 items dominated by Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's Tehran funeral and his son Mojtaba's decree reappointing Mohseni Ejei as judiciary chief, IDF chief Zamir touring Beaufort Ridge in south Lebanon with a strike near Nabatieh, and Jerusalem Post reporting Iran plans Strait of Hormuz tolls and a legal complaint over Khamenei's assassination.

threads.label: Khamenei state funeral enters second day
threads.summary: Iran's funeral for slain former supreme leader Ali Khamenei continued at Imam Khomeini Mosalla in Tehran, with regime channels broadcasting crowd scenes, military commanders' eulogies and Iraqi Hashd al-Shaabi securing Najaf and Karbala processions. The Jerusalem Post reported new supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei did not attend for fear of assassination, while Iran International said Quran verses were tailored for foreign delegations.

threads.label: Mojtaba Khamenei reappoints judiciary chief
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB reported that new Supreme Leader Ayatollah Seyyed Mostafa (Mojtaba) Khamenei issued a decree reappointing Ayatollah Mohseni Ejei as head of the judiciary under Article 157 of the Constitution. The Jerusalem Post noted human rights groups refer to Mohseni-Eje'i as the "Judge of Death".

threads.label: IDF Zamir tours Beaufort, strike near Nabatieh
threads.summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt.-Gen. Eyal Zamir toured the Beaufort Castle/Qal'at al-Shiqf ridge in southern Lebanon, describing the area as "saturated with terror infrastructure" including Hezbollah tunnels built with Iranian funding, and called Hezbollah "exhausted". Lebanese media and Iranian state outlets reported an Israeli airstrike between Kfar Tebnit and Nabatieh al-Fawqa.

threads.label: Lebanon-Israel framework agreement
threads.summary: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun defended the new framework agreement with Israel, telling critics "I am not in love with Israel, but give me another solution." A Jerusalem Post opinion piece argued military achievements alone cannot sustain the Lebanon framework.

threads.label: Gaza: strikes, tribunal, UNRWA exclusion
threads.summary: The IDF said strikes last week killed Muhammad Najib Ashour, a Nukhba platoon commander, and Tamer Saeed Abu Nakhal, a Hamas cell commander, while Israel is building a special tribunal for Hamas prosecutions with first trials expected no earlier than 2028. The Palestinian Authority rejected the Trump Board of Peace's decision to exclude UNRWA from the "new Gaza" plan.

threads.label: Iran regional posture: Hormuz, Houthis, UAE
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iran plans to implement tolls in the Strait of Hormuz despite Trump's objections, that spokeswoman Fatemeh Mohajerani said Tehran will pursue a legal complaint against Israel and the US over Khamenei's assassination, and that Iranian-backed Houthis have been reinforcing Yemen frontlines over the past month. A separate report disclosed Israel deployed an Iron Dome system and dozens of IDF troops to the UAE during the recent war with Iran.

threads.label: Iranian military and political messaging
threads.summary: Iranian commanders including navy chief, Quds Force's Qaani, army commander-in-chief Hatami, police chief Radan and parliament speaker Qalibaf used funeral-day platforms to pledge vengeance, with Qalibaf telling Hamas's leadership council chief that "diplomacy seeks to consolidate battlefield gains" and "we have no peace with America". IRIB also reported Bandar Abbas International Airport resumed operations after a four-month suspension and that a US Navy helicopter crashed in the Arabian Sea with one person missing.
